name: CP range type
citation: HL7 v2.3 Chapter 2 sec 2.8.8 CP - composite price, HL7 Table 0298 - CP range type

entries.description: Pro-rate. Apply this price to this interval, pro-rated by whatever portion of the interval is used.
Flat-rate. Apply the entire price to this interval, do not pro-rate the price if the full interval is not used.
